source.name: Travel Boots
source.description:
Fast Movement
Teleports its owner to help the home/away battle if the owner survives the current battle.

Active ability: Instant
Instantly teleports off the farthest square that allows it to attack an enemy. Generates 20 on activation.

Max distance: 800
